about: Approved free illustration sets (D-88). Each was checked at its source on 2026-10-02; re-check before adding files. 'kind' says how it arrives: npm (package.json, `npm install`), urls or zip (`py tools/fetch_assets.py <id>`). Nothing paid, nothing that needs a purchased licence, nothing share-alike, nothing with a no-redistribution clause.

sets.name: Microsoft Fluent Emoji (Flat)
sets.attribution: not required in the video; keep the MIT notice with the files (the npm package carries it)
sets.use: objects and props at hero size: laptop, calendar, books, potted plant, light bulb, envelope...

sets.name: Open Doodles (Pablo Stanley)
sets.verified_from: https://opendoodles.com/ footer: 'Free for Commercial and Personal Use. No need to credit, license, or anything.' with the CC0 badge
sets.use: loose hand-drawn people for the whiteboard, chalk and sketch registers

sets.name: Lukasz Adam free illustrations
sets.verified_from: https://lukaszadam.com/illustrations: 'Free SVG illustrations (commercial and personal use) under the CC0 license (MIT license). No attribution required.' The items labelled premium on that page are NOT listed here.
sets.use: flat scenes and people at work (desks, storefronts, city landscapes, video calls) as composition references and spot art

sets.name: Kenney Furniture Kit
sets.verified_from: https://opengameart.org/content/furniture-kit: License(s) CC0; 'Credit Kenney.nl ... this is not mandatory'
sets.use: isometric furniture renders (PNG) for iso rooms; raster, so colours cannot follow the style

sets.name: E2 kit drawn by Claude in Cowork (bake-off, D-102)
sets.origin: Loom's own: drawn in this repository by Claude in Cowork (D-102); the licence field is a closed value the tools read (B6, 2026-10-08)

sets.name: E2 AI-generated layers (bake-off, D-102)
sets.licence: model output owned by the requester under the provider's terms; NOT cleared for client use until the terms are read
sets.cleared_note: lab pages only (the E2 bake-off); a lesson build refuses it until Kshitij clears the terms (B6, 2026-10-08)
sets.verified_from: generated on Kshitij's PC by tools/e2_bakeoff/generate.py
sets.use: E2 bake-off variant C only; not for lessons

not_approved.name: Illlustrations.co
not_approved.why: only the older packs are CC0 and the site now mixes premium assets under a no-redistribution licence; not confident which files are which, so reference only

not_approved.name: Humaaans
not_approved.why: 'free for personal and commercial use' but not a formal licence; reference only until verified

not_approved.name: unDraw
not_approved.why: licence forbids compiling its art into a library or pack; reference only

not_approved.name: Twemoji, OpenMoji, Streamline free
not_approved.why: CC BY / CC BY-SA: need credit (and share-alike); not used
